description: This PHP source file defines the 'SagemakerEdgeManagerClient' class, a client for interacting with Amazon Sagemaker Edge Manager, including method definitions for various operations such as getDeployments, getDeviceRegistration, and sendHeartbeat.

classes.name: SagemakerEdgeManagerClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Sagemaker Edge Manager service, extending the base AwsClient class, providing methods to interact with the service.
